ex.en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe
And [by] the even [number] and the odd
So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds
